title: Storey Architecture intro
description: A black band taller than the window (110% on phones, 120% on desktop) with two short white statements set side by side in the right half and a wide empty field below them for a scene. On desktop a small paper card with a dark preview window and an underlined mono link slides up as the band arrives and then sticks to the top-right corner. Statements rise in as they enter.
notes: drawn with bg-foreground: a black band on light themes, a pale one on dark themes
scene fills the whole band behind the copy (the original runs a WebGL scene there); empty shows a faint surface
the preview card is desktop only
